dataset.name: Protein-Protein Interaction Interface Benchmark Dataset
dataset.description: A benchmark dataset of 1677 protein crystal structures with 844 physiological and 833 non-physiological homodimer interfaces for evaluating protein-protein interface scoring functions. Ideal for machine learning applications in structural bioinformatics. This package is derived from the benchmark of Schweke et al. (2023, Proteomics 23(17):e2200323, doi:10.1002/pmic.202200323). It uses the post-publication curated annotation file (30 April 2023), in which 16 interface labels were revised relative to the published split of 836 physiological and 841 non-physiological interfaces.
